- [x] 2026-07-27 | 2eb5775 | CLAUDE.md | **Offline/failure tests must open the context with `serviceWorkers: 'block'`** (S165 — the session's most reusable finding). `sw.js` calls `skipWaiting()` + `clients.claim()`, so the worker activates on the **first** load and then serves `/data/` from the version-independent `DATA_CACHE` — and **service-worker requests bypass Playwright's `page.route`**. A route that aborts `/data/` therefore stops blocking the moment the worker is live: the fetch succeeds, no failure path runs, and the test reports the happy path while looking like it tested failure. Added to the Playwright recipe with the one-line fix.

- [x] 2026-07-27 | 02f4ed0 | hebrew_dictionary.html | **The Dictionary hung on "Loading dictionary…" forever when the network blocked its corpus** (S165 Pass F; **P2, and the only tool of seven that crashed**). The corpus fetch is kicked off at **parse time** while `js/i18n.js` is **deferred**, so a fast failure lands in `.catch()` before `I18n` exists — and a bare `I18n.t()` on an undeclared global **throws a ReferenceError**, killing the handler before it could set the message or hide the progress bar. Fallback is the CSV's own `en` value, so **no new copy**. **Verified:** data blocked × EN/HE × light/dark, **plus the same matrix with `js/i18n.js` deliberately delayed 1.2 s past the failure** to force the pre-ready ordering — all 8 show the correct localized message, bar hidden, 0 pageerror; happy path unaffected (loader hides, 100 result cards); pre-fix replay reproduces the ReferenceError.

So the change is **not purely additive**, and the changelog says so. (2) *Normalization* — measured, not assumed: NFC(FB1F) = `05F2 05B7`, i.e. FB1F is on the **composition-exclusion list and NFC actively DECOMPOSES it**, never recomposing. Normalized text therefore never contains FB1F ⇒ the cmap entry (raw/legacy bytes) and the ccmp rule (typed/normalized sequence) are **both** load-bearing, neither sufficient alone. Tile on the Yiddish panel gated on `nikkud.enabled` (the same gate the bake uses, so the tab never promises a glyph that will not ship), clicking routes to ײ (untraced → jumps to yud; traced → Width slider + the read-only `legend_wideform`); QA build-check entry; the stale exclusion comment re-trued. **Two defects caught that the prompt did not name:** the ccmp block's gate keyed on `builtPrecomposed`/`builtPerLetter` alone, so with nikkud on and yud traced but no BeGeD-KeFeT base traced **both are empty and the FB1F rule would have silently vanished**; and the Hebrew changelog is `CHANGELOG_ORDER` + `CUR_KEY` driven, so an English-only `HELP_CONTENT.about` entry is invisible to non-English readers — the very trap that lost v5.10–v5.13 (the previous commit was a backfill of two of them).
